verdict.rationale: Secureframe's integrations page cites syncing with "hundreds" of tools (100+ integrations) for automated evidence collection. The evidence touches cloud services (GDPR config checks), identity/SSO (shadow-IT detection), and ticketing (Jira, plus tasks syncing to ticketing tools), and an API/custom-integrations path covers tools without a native integration. Missing for 10: named HR, code-hosting and MDM integrations; any documentation of read-only or least-privilege scopes; a per-integration catalog detail page; independent or hands-on corroboration.
